definitions.procedure: mir_eval.chord.evaluate(ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels): the estimate is cropped or padded with 'N' to the truth span (mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals), both are cut at every boundary of either (mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals), and each comparison is weighted by segment duration (mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy)
definitions.root: mir_eval.chord.root: same root; reference 'X' segments are left out of the weighting
definitions.majmin: mir_eval.chord.majmin: same root and the same maj/min/N class; reference chords whose quality is not maj, min or N are left out
definitions.sevenths: mir_eval.chord.sevenths: same root and quality among maj, min, 7, maj7, min7, N; other reference qualities are left out
definitions.other_mir_eval_chord_scores: every other score mir_eval.chord.evaluate returns (thirds, triads, tetrads, mirex, *_inv, seg)
definitions.label_normalisation: labels such as C, Cm, Cmaj7, Amin7, F#m7b5, C/E, N.C. are rewritten in Harte syntax (C:maj, C:min, C:maj7, A:min7, F#:hdim7, C:maj/3, N) before scoring; labels.normalized lists each rewrite and labels.unparsed every label that could not be read

processing: estimated chord 'N' at 0.0 s has end <= start; dropped
